title: Q-FIND-ultrastable: make https://ultrastable.io/ findable (2 gaps)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** findable workflow, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe ultrastable
**Prediction:** findable_gaps <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** paid listings, new accounts, and any page that is not this property's own
**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe ultrastable
**Status:** open

https://ultrastable.io/ is missing what search engines and AI agents read: feed link; robots.txt blocks every crawler. Fix the property's own pages (shared seed modules first, so every system gets it). Closed by the same daily reading.
